how_derived: On paper. The leak test calls a signal function twice per candidate, in time order: with a view of the whole stream and with a view cut at the candidate's own time. The first candidate for which the two answers differ fails the backtest.

signals_why.leaky_outcome: S09-C1 is on P-M2 (side YES), which resolves NO at t=30: with the future the function answers 10000, at t=2 it can only return the recorded 505000.
signals_why.leaky_last_quote: S09-C1: both quotes of P-M2 are 500000, no difference. S09-C2 (t=3) is on P-M1, whose last quote in the whole stream is 420000 (t=6); at t=3 the last visible quote is 400000.
signals_why.honest_mean: uses only quotes dated at or before the candidate: identical answers in both views for all 8 candidates.

honest_decisions_why: a mean of past quotes is at most the current price plus a few thousand ppm; after the cost of 10000 no net edge is above 20000: a signal without information does not trade.
stated_limit: The test sees only what goes through the view. A function that reads files behind the harness's back is not detected.
